name: SoftwareOne
employee_basis: Year-end 2025 global employees after Crayon combination; audited annual report.

go_live.description: May 15, 2024 earnings-call transcript says Workday went live a few weeks earlier. Likely spring 2024, but no exact day/month inferred. Minimum core HCM launch completed; Crayon still used separate HRIS in 2025, so do not claim combined group fully migrated.

contacts.notes: Public profile corroborates SoftwareOne and strategic HR remit; case links her to Workday deployment.

evidence.reason: Year-end 2025 workforce total 12,973 after Crayon integration.
Nina Janorschke appointed CHRO, superseding older Julia Braun materials.
Docebo learning platform consumes Workday employee IDs; Talentsoft decommissioned November 2025 and unified learning planned 2026.
H1 2026 growth 11.6% and adjusted EBITDA margin 24.9%; no HR tool purchasing deadline.
Post-merger systems harmonization has concrete 2026 scope; separate HRIS persisted in reporting year.
Public professional role identified; direct verified contact channel, team mutual connection and willingness to buy are not established.

why_now: Crayon integration, a new CHRO and consolidation of HR/learning systems create current identity, data and process harmonization needs. Initial Workday launch was around spring 2024; exact date unavailable.
research_notes: Julia Braun is no longer CHRO according to March 2026 official release. Old case-study HQ spelling Stand corrected to Stans. No scores assigned.
